name: Moroccan Style Chicken with Zucchini & Quinoa

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup quinoa
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash zucchini and tomatoes. Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Medium dice tomatoes. Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
4 tomatoes
1 medium yellow onion
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned but not cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Return pan to stove and add more oil. Add onion, garlic, and zucchini. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Return chicken to pan. Add tomatoes, honey, cinnamon, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and cook until chicken is cooked through and zucchini is tender, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to pan (save the rest for garnishing) while the ingredients cook.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, top with chicken and sauce, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!
